item.title: moonshotai/kimi-k2.6: service-access
item.description: 2026-10-31: Kimi API access: closed to newly registered users from 31 October 2026; existing users are unaffected by this initial closure. Kimi plans to retire the K2 series by the end of December 2026; no exact shutdown date is given. This first-party notice does not establish withdrawal of independently hosted routes or public weights. The quote on this card retains its own source and terms. Source: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/models
